content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To start working out, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase a high-quality yoga mat (1 hour)
Step 2. Research local gym membership rates (2 hours)
Step 3. Create a personalized strength training routine (3 hours)
Step 4. Buy a pair of supportive running shoes (45 minutes)
Step 5. Sign the gym contract and pay fees (30 minutes)
Step 6. Watch instructional videos on proper squat form (1 hour)
Step 7. Clear out a dedicated space in the garage for home sets (2 hours)
Step 8. Pack a gym bag with a towel and water bottle (10 minutes)
Step 9. Post a "day one" photo on social media for accountability (5 minutes)
Step 10. Download a fitness tracking mobile app (5 minutes)
Step 11. Purchase a set of adjustable dumbbells (20 minutes)
Step 12. Create a user profile in the fitness app (10 minutes)
Step 13. Set a recurring alarm for morning workouts (2 minutes)
Step 14. Order moisture-wicking athletic clothing online (30 minutes)
Step 15. Measure current body weight and waist circumference (10 minutes)
Step 16. Consult with a doctor for a physical checkup (1 hour)
Step 17. Wash and dry new workout clothes (90 minutes)
Step 18. Perform a light dynamic stretching warm-up (15 minutes)
Step 19. Buy a large reusable water jug (15 minutes)
Step 20. Fill the water jug with ice and filtered water (5 minutes)
Step 21. Organize the home workout equipment (30 minutes)
Step 22. Drive to the fitness center (20 minutes)
Step 23. Scan the membership card at the front desk (1 minute)
Step 24. Research the benefits of different protein powders (1 hour)
Step 25. Mix a post-workout protein shake (5 minutes)
Step 26. Read a book on basic exercise physiology (4 hours)
Step 27. Plan a weekly healthy meal prep menu (2 hours)
Step 28. Drink a large glass of water (2 minutes)
Step 29. Clean the garage floor to prepare for equipment (1 hour)
Step 30. Take a "before" progress photo (5 minutes)
Step 31. Shop for healthy groceries and lean proteins (90 minutes)
Step 32. Practice bodyweight lunges in front of a mirror (15 minutes)
Step 33. Set up a workout playlist on a music app (20 minutes)
Step 34. Ask a friend to be a workout partner (10 minutes)
Step 35. Perform a set of push-ups to failure (2 minutes)
Step 36. Put on the clean workout clothes and shoes (10 minutes)
Step 37. Complete a 30-minute introductory treadmill walk (30 minutes)
Step 38. Apply deodorant and pre-workout balm (5 minutes)
Step 39. Review the workout plan for the day (10 minutes)
Step 40. Perform 5 minutes of jumping jacks (5 minutes)
Step 41. Designate a specific spot for house keys and gym pass (5 minutes)
Step 42. Begin the main weightlifting circuit (1 hour)
Step 43. Clean out the refrigerator of junk food (45 minutes)
Step 44. Put on a heart rate monitor (2 minutes)
Step 45. Ask neighbors for gym recommendations (20 minutes)
Step 46. Set a long-term fitness goal (15 minutes)
Step 47. Purchase a tub of whey protein (15 minutes)
Step 48. Perform a 10-minute cool-down walk (10 minutes)
Step 49. Research different types of protein supplements (30 minutes)
Step 50. Prepare a gym bag for the next day (10 minutes)
